offering_description.value: Jacobs provides engineering, design, and program management to governments, utilities, and companies developing infrastructure and advanced facilities. It delivers projects through multidisciplinary teams and operates water and wastewater facilities for clients. Its PA Consulting business advises companies and public agencies on strategy, technology, and product development.

primary_products.value: transportation analytics software; flood modeling software; water utility monitoring software

primary_services.value: engineering and design; program and construction management; water and wastewater facility operations; strategy and technology consulting; product design and development

customer_segment.value: B2G: transportation agencies, municipalities, public water authorities, and national government departments; B2B: utilities, semiconductor manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, data center developers, and other private enterprises

end_markets.value: transportation infrastructure; water and wastewater; advanced manufacturing and data centers; life sciences; energy and utilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: engineering, design, capital program management, and facility operations; service fees: strategy, technology, and product development consulting; subscription: access to cloud-based transportation and infrastructure analytics tools; licensing or royalties: licenses for flood modeling software
revenue_model.category: project or contract; service fees; subscription; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses engineering and consulting expertise to design, manage, and operate facilities for public and private clients; software / platform: turns mobility and infrastructure data into analytics and modeling tools for agencies, utilities, and engineering teams

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: infrastructure and facility engineering, program management, utility operations, digital tools, and strategy and technology consulting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: client account teams, public procurement bids, and private requests for proposals; online: company websites and cloud platforms for specialized software

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: engineering licensure, construction safety and building codes, and environmental permits for water and wastewater operations
